profile.summary: A California professional corporation that runs a physical therapy clinic in Emeryville, doing business as Emeryville Sports Physical Therapy. It offers one-on-one physical therapy, sports science and massage therapy for sports injuries, recovery after surgery and chronic pain. It is part of the STAC Physical Therapy group of clinics.

sources.title: STAC PHYSICAL THERAPY EMERYVILLE, INC. - OpenCorporates

review.notes: The legal name matches exactly an active CA professional corporation (OpenCorporates 4169640) and STAC's own site lists the Emeryville clinic at emeryvillept.com, matching the agenda city; STAC advertises school-district and pediatric services consistent with a special education PT contract. Contact details are confirmed on emeryvillept.com; the 'doing business as' link rests on STAC's site pointing to that clinic, and the surgery/chronic-pain wording is only loosely supported by the clinic page but is not misleading.
